meta.title: wp-portfolio
meta.description: Gonzalo Alcina's portfolio theme with its living design system.
meta.author: Gonzaloalcina

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// Pretty permalinks, as on the live site: notes live under /notes/.
update_option( 'permalink_structure', '/notes/%postname%/' );

// Rank Math prints its tags only after registration is skipped or connected.
update_option( 'rank_math_registration_skip', 1 );

// The site is a Person in Rank Math's schema; portfolio-core completes it
// from Site settings (job title, bio, profiles as sameAs).
$titles                        = (array) get_option( 'rank-math-options-titles', array() );
$titles['knowledgegraph_type'] = 'person';
$titles['knowledgegraph_name'] = 'Gonzalo Alcina';
update_option( 'rank-math-options-titles', $titles );

// The living design system page: noindex in Rank Math, demo card icon.
$page_id = wp_insert_post(
	array(
		'post_type'   => 'page',
		'post_title'  => 'Design system',
		'post_name'   => 'design-system',
		'post_status' => 'publish',
	)
);
update_post_meta( $page_id, 'rank_math_robots', array( 'noindex' ) );
update_post_meta( $page_id, 'demo_card_icon', 'gauge' );

// Main menu (nav-a in the header), assigned to the theme's primary location.
// URLs are built at boot: every Playground instance has its own address.
$menu_id = wp_create_nav_menu( 'Main' );
foreach ( array( 'About', 'Work', 'Services', 'Notes', 'Contact' ) as $label ) {
	wp_update_nav_menu_item(
		$menu_id,
		0,
		array(
			'menu-item-title'  => $label,
			'menu-item-url'    => home_url( '/' . strtolower( $label ) . '/' ),
			'menu-item-type'   => 'custom',
			'menu-item-status' => 'publish',
		)
	);
}
set_theme_mod( 'nav_menu_locations', array( 'primary' => $menu_id ) );

flush_rewrite_rules();
